crewNotes.text: Note: tobacco is not duty-free in Malaysia - declare any cigarettes. General traveller allowances; crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with RMCD. Compiled from the cited RMCD guide, pending final authority review.

rules.text: Wine, spirits, beer or malt liquor not exceeding 1 litre in total is exempt from duty and tax.
Travellers entering or leaving Malaysia with cash and bearer negotiable instruments amounting to or exceeding USD 10,000 must declare it (Customs Form No. 7).

declarationRequirements.text: For air travellers, goods (excluding cigarettes and tobacco) up to RM1,000 in total value are exempt; above that, goods must be declared.

rules.text: Cigarettes and tobacco products are NOT duty-free in Malaysia; any quantity must be declared and is subject to duty and tax.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
